title: Resolution urging Albany to protect Mitchell-Lama tenants' rights
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, A.6432/S.4236, which would create an independent agency to handle Mitchell-Lama tenant complaints about harassment, rent increases and building services. The bill would also require Comptroller verification of rent increases, provide tenants legal help in landlord-tenant cases and require judges handling these cases to have Mitchell-Lama expertise. The resolution cites state audits finding unsafe conditions and financial mismanagement at several Mitchell-Lama developments in New York City.
